note: Rwanda, read on the Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration's own pages on 2026-10-30. The C2 permit is issued to a professional player or artist on an employment contract, a CV, a recommendation letter and a police clearance; it costs 100,000 Rwandan francs and is valid up to two years, renewed on the contract and recommendation. A first residence permit is applied for within a 15-day grace period after arrival (online, through Irembo), so in the country. A work permit holder may change employers within the permit's validity on informing the Directorate in writing, so the work is not tied to one sponsor. EAC citizens pay nothing for a residence permit, a waiver the form doesn't hold; the Directorate names no separate free movement route on these pages. Permanent residence exists but its page says only to contact the Directorate before applying, so it isn't written. Decision time and naturalisation's count aren't on these pages.

sources.title: DGIE, Employment permits
sources.said: C2: Professional Player or Artist ... Permit issued to a professional player or artist. REQUIREMENTS FOR RECURRING APPLICATION * The copy of employment contract. ... REQUIREMENTS FOR A RENEW APPLICATION * The copy of employment contract. * Recommendation letter APPLICATION FEES * 100,000 Frw PERMIT VALIDITY *up to two years

sources.title: DGIE, Permits: general information
sources.said: To the applicants applying for residence permit for the first time, grace period is 15 days upon arrival in the country. ... EAC citizens do not pay for resident permit ... A work permit holder has the right to change employers during the period of validity of the work permit, but he/she is required to inform the office of the Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration in writing.

sources.title: DGIE, Permanent Permits
sources.said: The applicant should contact DGIE before making any application.
